requirements.statement: scripts/run_measurement.py runs one measurement script as a child with enforced caps (wall clock default 300 s, declared override, hard maximum 900 s without --approve-decision N; generated data under its own output dir, default 1 GiB; peak RSS default 3 GiB); on a breach it kills only the process group it started, deletes the data, prints one plain line and exits non-zero.
The runner always deletes the generated-data dir at the end (success or failure) unless --keep is given, and reports bytes written.
Every measure_*.py declares MEASUREMENT_BUDGET as a literal; a registry test fails when one lacks it or declares over the hard maximum without a decision number.
A test fails if any doc, brief or script in docs/, scripts/ or packages/*/scripts invokes a measure_*.py directly instead of through run_measurement.py.
The runner does no I/O at import, and its tests use tiny fake measure scripts with low caps so each cap trips within seconds.
